title: The field made by a held source as a common local scale for a test body

key_results.statement: Partial expectation of the total contract in the field state: $\bar C_\varphi=C_{bc}+\gamma\sum_x N_\varphi(x)Q_x+E_\varphi\mathbb 1$, fixed by $C$ and $\varphi$; its split into own and field-made parts is listing-dependent.

Couplings (a), (c), every field state, product starts, every real $\lambda$: $\lVert\Psi(\lambda)-\xi(\lambda)\otimes\varphi(\lambda)\rVert\le\delta(\lambda)=|\gamma|c_Q\int_0^{|\lambda|}\sigma_\Phi(s\mu)d\mu$, $s=\operatorname{sgn}\lambda$, with $\xi$ evolving by $\bar C_{\varphi(\lambda)}$; first order in $\gamma$, the test body's change of the field.

Same class: the view of body and medium obeys $\lVert\rho(\lambda)-|\xi(\lambda)\rangle\langle\xi(\lambda)|\rVert_1\le2\delta(\lambda)^2(1+|\gamma|c_W\hat\phi(\lambda)|\lambda|)$; the first-order term vanishes after the field trace, so evolution by $\bar C_{\varphi(\lambda)}$ holds to first order in $\gamma$ with a second-order remainder, small for $\delta\ll1$ and $|\gamma|c_W\hat\phi|\lambda|\delta^2\ll1$.

With $B_{x,k}$ the level-$k$ on-site operator of $ ar C_\varphi$ minus its field-independent scalar background $\hat V^{(0)}_x$ ($K_x+C_c$ in the setting's listing): on-site $
u(x)M_k\sigma_3+E_\varphi\mathbb 1_2$ with $
u=1+\gamma N_\varphi$; hopping $	au$ for (a), $	au rac12(
u(x)+
u(x+1))$ for (c); $B_{x,k}$ is invariant under place-dependent relistings between body and record terms; the factorization $
u(x)M_k$ and the constant in $V_{x,k}$ are listing-dependent.

For (a) and (c), every field state and every place, R3 holds with $\Gamma(x)=\gamma(N_\varphi(x+1)-N_\varphi(x))\sigma_3$; the hopping scales with the on-site factor (bond mean) for (c), not for (a) wherever $\gamma(N_\varphi(x+1)-N_\varphi(x))\neq0$.
Control: coupling only the rest term, $Q_x=\Pi_x\sigma_3\otimes m\mathbb 1_N$; R3 fails and the fall from rest is level dependent at every place with $\gamma(N_\varphi(x+1)-N_\varphi(x))\neq0$.

u>0$: clock-rate ratio $r(y)/r(x)=

u(x)=M_{y,k}/M_{x,k}$ for every pair of levels and both branches, exact in $ ar C_\varphi$.

Branch start at rest, local slope, first order in gradients: $a_{k,\sigma}(0)=-	au_{m loc}(x_0)^2\gamma N'(x_0)/
u(x_0)$ with the lattice slope $N'$, level and branch independent; (4.24) holds with $v_{\max}=	au_{m loc}(x_0)d_0$ up to the curvature term $\gamma N''(x_0)/(2
u(x_0))$; $v_{\max}=	au d_0$ for (a), $	au
u(x_0)d_0$ for (c).

Lowest adapted state $u_g^{\otimes N_f}$, unique for every real $g_s$; under $|g_s|\ll t_f\omega_{\min}$: $N(y)=n-\frac{2ng_s}{t_f}\Lambda^+(y,x_s)$ up to $R_N\lesssim N_f g_s^2/(t_f\omega_{\min})^2$.
On the ring, $\Lambda^+(x,x_s)=\frac{L^2-1}{12L}-\frac{\varrho(L-\varrho)}{2L}$ with $\varrho$ the ring distance from the source.

Made field, first order in $g_s$: $r(y)/r(x)=1+\frac{2n\bar\gamma g_s}{t_f}[\Lambda^+(x,x_s)-\Lambda^+(y,x_s)](1+O(\varepsilon_\nu))+O(|\bar\gamma|R_N)$ with $\bar\gamma=\gamma/(1+\gamma n)$, valid for $\varepsilon_\nu\ll1$.

Made field, first order in $g_s$, local slope: $a_{k,\sigma}(0)=\frac{2n\bar\gamma g_s}{t_f}\tau_0^2\,\partial_\ell\Lambda^+(x_0,x_s)(1+O(\varepsilon_\nu))+O(\tau_0^2|\bar\gamma|R_N)$, level and branch independent.

Ring, graph coordinates: $r(y)/r(x)=1+\frac{n\bar\gamma g_s}{t_fL}[\varrho_y(L-\varrho_y)-\varrho_x(L-\varrho_x)]$, $a=-\frac{n\bar\gamma g_s}{t_f}\tau_0^2(1-2\varrho/L)$ (positive away from the source along the shorter arc), for $w\ll\varrho$, $w\ll L/2-\varrho$, with the errors of (5.11), (5.12).

Tori, graph coordinates, $1\ll\varrho\ll L$, $w\ll|\varrho_\parallel|$: clock ratio logarithmic ($D=2$) or $1/\varrho$ ($D=3$), acceleration along $\ell$ the projection of a radial vector $\propto\varrho^{-1}$ or $\varrho^{-2}$; signs exactly those of $\gamma(N(y)-N(x))$ and $-\gamma N'$; when $R_N$ is below the first-order differences, for $g_s\gamma>0$ slower clocks and fall towards decreasing $\varrho$, for $g_s\gamma<0$ reversed.

Recorded geometry: on $\ell$ recorded distance $d_0s$ and graph separation $\min(s,L-s)$ coincide iff $s\le L/2$; ring: $a^{\rm rec}=\frac{n\bar\gamma g_s}{t_f}\tau_0^2(1-2s/L)$ towards the recorded position of $x_s$, so for $g_s\gamma>0$ the recorded fall is towards it for $s<L/2$ and away for $s>L/2$; on the tori the transverse separation has no recorded counterpart.

open_issues: The bounds (5.2) and (5.15) grow with |λ|, and (5.15) contains φ_max ≤ N_f, crude for many field objects; a bound using the field gap t_f ω_min (non-growing first-order joint remainder plus the second-order own mark) is not derived.
The remainder R_N of (5.8), taken from (3.9) per field object, is crude and the sign conditions it gives shrink fast with L; a sharp second-order profile is not derived.
Non-product starts and non-stationary field states for items 3–4 (λ-dependent profile) are not treated.

Regions with ν(x) ≤ 0 or without (W2), the neighbourhoods ϱ ≲ w of the source, the ring antipode, ϱ ~ L and the foot point |ϱ_∥| ≲ w on the tori, and starts across the closing bond of ℓ are outside the formulas.
The setting fixes no record of the source and no recorded transverse separation on the tori; a recorded distance to a source off ℓ needs a record beyond the single line ℓ.

consistency_checks.check: Dimensions of the remainders, the clock ratio and the acceleration
g_s = 0 or γ = 0: uniform field, Γ = 0, ratio 1, no fall, vanishing remainders (5.2) and (5.15)
Sharp field (t_f = 0, joint eigenvector of all Φ_x): (5.2) and (5.15) exact, given lapse field of 05-ilang-free-fall recovered
